job: Show that an account or a provider has been verified.
purpose: A small seal that sits after a name. 14px by default, 18px at data-size="lg". Give it an accessible name such as "Verified".
useWhen: A name in a card, a profile or a list belongs to a checked provider or account.

avoidWhen.when: The state is a general label like Beta or New.
A status with a word, such as Passed.

variants.useWhen: Beside a heading or a profile name.
